subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Ranen feels that the __notion__ of democracy is a farce.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Reality**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Notion **means an individual's conception or impression of something known, experienced, or imagined. (किसी ज्ञात, अनुभव या कल्पना की गई किसी चीज़ के बारे में किसी व्यक्ति की धारणा या धारणा)

 
 
• **For example- ***I had a vague notion that I had seen her before.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Reality **means a thing that is actually experienced, not just imagined. (एक ऐसी चीज़ जो वास्तव में अनुभव की जाती है, न कि केवल कल्पना की गई)
 
 
• **For example- ***Films portray war as heroic and exciting, but the reality is very different.*
 
 
 
• So, the **opposite **of 'Notion' would be something that is genuine or true, which is 'Reality'.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the other words.
 
 
• **Quotient**: A number which is the result when one number is divided by another. (वह संख्या जो तब प्राप्त होती है जब एक संख्या को दूसरी संख्या से विभाजित किया जाता है)
 
• **Law**: An official rule of a country or state that says what people may or may not do. (क़ानून, विधि; किसी देश या राज्‍य का अधिकारिक नियम जो बताता है कि लोग क्‍या करें या न करें)
 
• **Portion**: A part or share of something larger. (किसी बड़ी चीज़ का हिस्सा)
